model_annotations.English: The plot illustrates the relationship between speed and performance for several configurations of a language model. The x-axis is labeled “Speed (Tokens/s)” and spans a linear scale from 20 to 160, with tick labels at intervals of 20. The y-axis is labeled “Performance (%) (Accuracy %)” and displays a linear scale from 60 to 80, with tick labels at intervals of 5. There are five lines displayed on the plot, each representing a different configuration. The first line, in blue with ‘x’ markers, starts at approximately 79% performance at a speed of 20 Tokens/s and decreases to approximately 68% at 160 Tokens/s. The second line, in grey with square markers, begins at approximately 76% performance at 20 Tokens/s and ends at approximately 64% performance at 160 Tokens/s. The third line, in purple with circle markers, starts at approximately 76% at 20 Tokens/s, declines to approximately 71% performance at 80 Tokens/s, then decreases to approximately 68% at 160 Tokens/s. The fourth line, in red with diamond markers, begins at approximately 73% performance at 20 Tokens/s and declines relatively steadily to approximately 65% performance at 160 Tokens/s. Finally, there are two dashed lines which are not part of the tracked configurations represented, a dotted grey line and a dashed black line. The dotted line starts at approximately 80% at 20 Tokens/s and declines to approximately 65% at 160 Tokens/s. Lastly, the dashed black line begins at approximately 78 % at 20 Tokens/s and declines to approximately 60% at 160 Tokens/s.
model_annotations.German:
The plot illustrates the relationship between speed and performance across several conditions. The x-axis is labeled “Speed (Tokens/s)” and has a linear scale ranging from 0 to 160, with tick labels at intervals of 20. The y-axis is labeled “Performance (Accuracy %)” and has a linear scale ranging from 65 to 85, with tick labels at intervals of 5. 

The line labeled “w/o Cache” is blue with ‘x’ markers and a solid line style, beginning at approximately 81.0 performance at a speed of 20, decreasing to approximately 76.0 performance at a speed of 80, and then ending at approximately 74.0 performance at a speed of 160. The line labeled “Refresh=2” is gray with square markers and a solid line style, starting at approximately 82.0 performance at a speed of 20, remaining relatively constant at approximately 81.5 performance between speeds of 20 and 60, and then ending at approximately 68.0 performance at a speed of 160. The line labeled “Refresh=4” is gray with circle markers and a solid line style; it begins at approximately 81.0 performance at a speed of 20, decreases to approximately 77.0 performance at a speed of 60, and then ends at approximately 65.5 performance at a speed of 160. The line labeled “Refresh=8” is red with diamond markers and a solid line style, starting at approximately 80.0 performance at a speed of 20, decreasing to approximately 71.5 performance at a speed of 60, and ending at approximately 64.0 performance at a speed of 160. The line labeled “Refresh=16” is dark blue with triangle markers and a solid line style, beginning at approximately 81.0 performance at a speed of 20, dropping to approximately 76.0 performance at a speed of 60, and ending at approximately 66.0 performance at a speed of 160. Finally, the plot includes two dashed lines labeled “LLaDA Pareto Front” which is dotted and begins at approximately 82.0 performance at a speed of 20 and ends at approximately 65.0 performance at a speed of 160, and "Cache Pareto Front" which is a solid dashed line starting at approximately 82.0 performance at a speed of 20 and ending at approximately 67.0 performance at a speed of 160.
